name: Gratefulness
overview: Scripture calls believers to a posture of gratefulness rooted in the recognition of God's sovereign goodness and provision. The Lord's people are invited to rejoice in every good gift He has given (Deuteronomy 26:11) and to bless His holy name with all their being (Psalms 103:1). This gratitude flows from understanding that God is our Creator and Shepherd (Psalms 100:3) and from recalling His great deeds and lovingkindnesses bestowed upon His people (Psalms 126:3; Isaiah 63:7). Thankfulness is expressed both in personal praise and communal acknowledgment of God's nearness and wondrous works (Psalms 75:1).
